endorsements.quote: Ultimately, beyond these technical and regulatory considerations, whether advanced or simple, AI should remain a support for clinicians’ judgement—not a substitute for it.

unlisted_practices: Harmonise regulatory requirements across jurisdictions for AI in healthcare.
Develop collaborative initiatives among researchers, funders, patients, and professional societies to simplify regulatory frameworks and facilitate early feasibility studies of AI.
Involve patients early and continuously in the design, governance, and communication of AI tools.
Standardise data systems and update clinical practice guidelines to support AI use.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint article discussing regulatory frameworks (MDR, AI Act), governance challenges, and human oversight requirements for AI in healthcare.
